name: Hybrid GDN + QSA
tagline: Three gated delta blocks, then one sparse-attention block.
description: Repeats GDN, GDN, GDN, QSA across 24 layers. GDN layers reuse the linear family's gated delta rule; QSA layers reuse the sparse family's selection with a 256-token budget, compression 4 and its indexer. The QSA positions train densely for the first 512 updates, then switch to sparse attention within the same budget.
mechanism: QSA: 256-token budget, compression 4, indexer with auxiliary loss on QSA layers only
512 dense burn-in updates, then joint sparse training; FFN 5760
limitations: Gated attention, n-grams, MoE, multi-token prediction and long-context continued pretraining of the source model are not reproduced. Registered and admitted within the shared budget; no formal result is published yet. Parameters, memory and speed are outcomes, not controls.
